title: Figure 12: 2-beam/2-detector interferometric measurement schematic and simulation
description: Left: cross-section schematic of a layered sample (100 nm Au, 220 nm SiO2, 440 nm SiC, 220 nm SiO2, 100 nm Au) with gratings of period D1 = 2.74 um and D2 = 2.94 um, two detectors D1 and D2, beams A-D, and a "Delay Line". Right: simulated plot of detector intensity versus micrometer position showing out-of-phase red and green sinusoidal curves, titled "Unequal grating phase interference: 0th, 2nd orders". Caption: "Figure 12. (Left): Schematic for 2-Beams/2-Detectors Interferometric Measurement. (Right): Numerical Simulation."
